title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer
jd_text:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer to join our team. This role owns the technical evaluation and end-to-end execution of AI infrastructure deployments — from data center due diligence and solution review, through cross- functional delivery coordination, to ongoing operations of production AI environments. You will act as a key technical owner bridging internal stakeholders and external  partners, ensuring infrastructure is delivered on time, to spec, and operated reliably at scale.Key Responsibilities• Conduct on-site data center assessments to evaluate whether candidate facilities meet AI infrastructure requirements.
• Review and validate AI infrastructure solution designs, identifying technical risks, gaps, and cost/performance trade-offs before sign-off.
• Coordinate with external partners, driving timelines, resolving technical issues, and ensuring deliverables meet internal requirements.
• Partner with internal business and engineering teams to translate requirements into deliverable technical specifications.
• Participate in and eventually take ownership of day-2 operations for live AI
environments — monitoring, incident response, capacity/health checks, firmware and lifecycle management, coordinating hardware maintenance as needed.
• Build and improve operational standards, runbooks, and documentation for
infrastructure delivery and operations to enable consistent execution across regions.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers/interns on hardware diagnostics, cluster tooling, and best practices.
• Track and report on project status and risks to management.

Who We Look For
Requirements
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in data center infrastructure, infrastructure deployment, or infrastructure operations.
• Solid understanding of high-performance compute server hardware, high-speed
networking (e.g., InfiniBand/RoCE), storage systems, and data center power & cooling fundamentals.
• Proven experience evaluating data center facilities and reviewing technical proposals for compute infrastructure.
• Strong track record coordinating complex, multi-party technical projects to closure, including working effectively with external partners and cross-regional teams.
• Hands-on experience with cluster orchestration and management tools (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes) and Linux system administration.
• Proficiency in scripting/automation (Python, Bash; Ansible/Terraform a plus).
• Familiarity with observability/monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and DCIM tooling.
• Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin highly preferred
• Strong ownership mentality, able to independently drive projects with minimal
supervision.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with high-performance storage / parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre,
GPFS/Spectrum Scale, WekaFS, VAST, Ceph) in AI infrastructure environments.
• Experience deploying/operating large-scale AI compute environments in a hyperscale or cloud environment.
• Data center or infrastructure certifications.
Location State(s)
US-California-Palo Alto
The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $124,800.00 to $283,800.00 per year. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
Employees hired for this position may be eligible for a sign on payment, relocation package, and restricted stock units, which will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
Subject to the terms and conditions of the plans in effect, hired applicants are also eligible for medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefits, and participation in the Company’s 401(k) plan. The Employee is also eligible for up to 15 to 25 days of vacation per year (depending on the employee’s tenure), up to 13 days of holidays throughout the calendar year, and up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
Your benefits may be adjusted to reflect your location, employment status, duration of employment with the company, and position level. Benefits may also be pro-rated for those who start working during the calendar year.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: US-California-Palo Alto

title: Sr. AI infra engineer
jd_text:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
About the Team
The AI Compute Centre sits within Tencent's Overseas IT department, acting as the bridge between internal AI infrastructure demand and the external resources that fulfil it. We play key roles in the full lifecycle of AI infrastructure clusters — from requirement gathering and capacity planning, through architectural design and development, to delivery, operations, and DevOps — across regions worldwide.
About the Role
You will lead the cloud/edge cloud infrastructure projects you are responsible for delivering. Your focus is to turn business and technical requirements into deliverable plans, hold suppliers accountable, coordinate data centre readiness, and ensure that new capacity is accepted and handed over to operations with clear ownership.
This is a cross-functional role. You will work with specialist engineers on compute, networking, storage, facilities, and security decisions; you are not expected to personally configure every system or run every benchmark. You should, however, be able to challenge assumptions, identify gaps between vendor commitments and delivered outcomes, and drive issues to resolution.
What You Will Do
● Translate demand into infrastructure requirements. Work with AI business and platform teams to define compute capacity, network bandwidth and latency, connectivity, data access, scalability, availability, and operational needs. Convert these into supplier requirements, evaluation criteria, delivery milestones, and acceptance criteria.
● Lead network design and delivery reviews. Review data centre fabric, inter-data-centre and WAN connectivity, routing, IP planning, network segmentation, resilience, and expansion plans with internal architects and suppliers. Ensure designs address both AI workload requirements and day-to-day operability.
● Manage network providers and delivery dependencies. Coordinate network equipment vendors, carriers, colocation partners, and system integrators on circuits, cross-connects, cabling, configuration handoffs, implementation windows, and fault escalation. Track responsibilities and resolve gaps between suppliers.
● Drive data centre readiness. Coordinate rack space, power, cooling, physical access, cabling, carrier connectivity, and installation prerequisites. Identify site or network dependencies that could delay cluster deployment.
● Own integration and acceptance governance. Coordinate compute, network, storage, and platform teams through installation, integration, testing, remediation, and sign-off. Require evidence for connectivity, bandwidth, latency, failover, and agreed cluster-level outcomes—not just confirmation that equipment has been installed.
● Manage delivery and service accountability. Maintain integrated plans, risks, decision logs, and supplier action trackers. Define handover documentation, monitoring expectations, incident escalation, change procedures, support boundaries, and service review cadence.
● Communicate technical risks clearly. Explain design trade-offs, unresolved defects, capacity constraints, and schedule impacts to both engineering teams and business stakeholders.

Who We Look For
Must-haves
● Substantial experience in infrastructure architecture, network engineering, technical delivery, or service management, typically 10+ years in relevant roles.
● Strong data centre or enterprise networking experience, with the ability to review network topology, routing, connectivity, redundancy, and capacity plans—not only manage project schedules.
● Working knowledge of TCP/IP, L2/L3 networking, VLANs, routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF, and common data centre network design principles.
● Experience delivering or operating networks across data centres, cloud environments, or multiple sites, including coordination with carriers, colocation providers, and network equipment vendors.
● Ability to review network test plans and evidence, identify gaps in connectivity or failover, and work with engineers and suppliers to resolve issues.
● Experience with a data centre migration, site deployment, colocation delivery, or comparable infrastructure transition involving multiple technical teams and external providers.
● Demonstrated experience managing suppliers through design review, delivery milestones, acceptance, escalation, and production handover.
● Ability to assess infrastructure proposals across compute, network, storage, availability, and operational support, while engaging specialists for detailed validation.
● Strong documentation and stakeholder communication skills. 
Nice to Have
● Experience evaluating or sourcing AI server capacity, AI infrastructure services, or large-scale compute platforms.
● Deeper experience with Spine-Leaf/Clos fabrics, EVPN-VXLAN, ECMP, MLAG, or inter-data-centre connectivity.
● Familiarity with InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, AI server cluster network design, high-performance storage, or cluster-level performance testing such as NCCL.
● Experience with high-density data centre deployments, including power and cooling constraints.
● Exposure to supplier SLAs, commercial evaluation, cost optimisation, disaster recovery, or service governance.
● Relevant networking, cloud, AI infrastructure, project management, or IT service management certifications.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

title: AI Compute Intern 108149
jd_text:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
Role SummaryWe are seeking a motivated Network Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Intern to join our AI Compute team, supporting the daily operations and maintenance of AI-accelerated high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure. In this role, you will work closely with internal business team and vendor's engineering team to build and operate clusters. This is a hands-on opportunity to gain direct exposure to cutting-edge AI infrastructure.
 
Team IntroductionThe AI Compute Centre sits within Tencent's Overseas IT department, acting as the bridge between internal AI infrastructure demand and the external resources that fulfil it. We play key roles in the full lifecycle of AI infrastructure clusters — from requirement gathering and capacity planning, through architectural design and development, to delivery, operations, and DevOps — across regions worldwide.
Key Responsibilities● Support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of high-end servers, storage servers, networking equipment, and software components in secure environments.
● Assist with hardware diagnostics, system functionality checks, and firmware updates as required.
● Collaborate with engineering teams to help deliver tailored customer environments (e.g., bare-metal systems, HPC clusters, Kubernetes, Slurm, etc.).
● Provide first-line engineering support for onsite operational issues, including troubleshooting hardware, network, and software problems, and firmware compliance.
● Document incident details, resolutions, and lessons learned to improve future problem-solving.
● Maintain clear, accurate, and up-to-date documentation to support knowledge sharing across the team.
● Participate in team meetings and knowledge-sharing sessions to foster collaboration and continuous learning.

Who We Look For
● Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
● Basic understanding of server hardware, firmware lifecycle, and Linux environments, with an awareness of physical and system-level security standards.
● Exposure to scripting languages such as Bash or Python.
● Familiarity with — or strong interest in — configuration management, CI/CD tools, workload managers, and cluster software (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes, BCM), and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
● Assist senior engineers in checking cluster network connectivity, including InfiniBand or RoCE links. Run predefined tests, collect results, and flag link or performance anomalies.
● Monitor dashboards for compute, storage, and management networks. Help record bandwidth, latency, and RDMA test results, and compare them with agreed baselines.
● Support AI infrastructure incident investigations by collecting switch, NIC, and host logs, updating incident records, and tracking vendor follow-up actions under guidance.
● Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

title: Associate, Global AI Policy
jd_text:
About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails
A.	About Tencent
       Tencent is a leading global technology and entertainment company focused on connecting people and developing innovative products and services. Founded in 1998 and publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2004, Tencent’s communication and social services, entertainment (video games, music, sports, and film/TV), fintech, cloud, and enterprise solutions are used by hundreds of millions of people around the world.
       Tencent has been recognized as one of the “World’s Best Employers” (Forbes), including as one of the “Best Workplaces for New Graduates” (2026); one of the “World’s Most Admired Companies” (Fortune); and one of the “World’s Best Companies” (Time). In addition to its headquarters in Shenzhen, Tencent maintains offices across Asia, Europe, North America, and Latin America, including Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Palo Alto, Los Angeles, New York, and Washington, D.C. To learn more about the company, visit www.Tencent.com (About Us). 
       B.	About the Role
       Tencent is seeking a highly motivated Associate, Global AI Policy to join its Global Public Affairs team in Palo Alto. This early-career position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, public policy, technology, and international affairs.
       The Associate will support Tencent's global AI policy efforts by researching emerging policy developments, monitoring legislative and regulatory activity, analyzing technology trends, and helping develop insights for Tencent businesses. The role will work closely with colleagues across public affairs, legal, compliance, and AI and Cloud product teams, while also engaging with external stakeholders including policymakers, think tanks, industry associations, academic institutions, and civil society organizations.
       While the position will be based in Palo Alto, the successful candidate will contribute to Tencent's assessment and understanding of broader AI trends globally, including the US but also Europe, Asia-Pacific, etc.Policy Research & Analysis
Monitor and analyze developments related to artificial intelligence, including machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI, semiconductors, and other emerging technologies.
Track and assess industry initiatives and policy developments in the United States and other key international markets.
Prepare concise policy briefings, research memoranda, presentations, and executive summaries for internal stakeholders.
Support analysis of AI policy trends and their potential implications for Tencent's business and technology strategy.
Identify emerging risks, opportunities, and policy developments relevant to Tencent's AI and cloud businesses.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with internal teams across public affairs, legal, compliance, product, engineering, and research functions.
Assist with the development of policy positions, consultation responses, and external-facing materials.
Support preparation for meetings, conferences, speaking engagements, and policy discussions.
Stakeholder Engagement
Assist in managing relationships with think tanks, academic institutions, trade associations, and policy organizations.
Support Tencent's participation in AI policy forums, conferences, workshops, and industry events.
Help coordinate internal and external meetings and maintain stakeholder engagement databases and tracking tools.

Who We Look For
We are looking for an intellectually curious individual who enjoys learning about complex issues and translating them into clear insights for business and policy teams. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, a disciplined researcher, and someone who is genuinely excited by the policy questions surrounding artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. Successful candidates may come from leading universities, graduate programs, consulting firms, think tanks, policy research organizations, or technology companies. Most importantly, they should possess strong analytical instincts, sound judgment, and a desire to help shape the future of AI policy in a rapidly changing global environment.
Specific qualifications include:
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. Relevant fields include Public Policy, International Affairs, Political Science, Economics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Law, or related disciplines.
Strong interest in artificial intelligence, technology policy, innovation, and emerging technologies.
Exceptional research, writing, and analytical skills are required.
Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and multi-cultural environment.
Familiarity with AI governance, technology regulation, or digital/cloud policy preferred.
Mandarin with international teams preferred but not required 
Experience conducting quantitative or qualitative policy research.

jd_text:
1.负责 AI Bot 系统的研发与落地，结合游戏玩法探索强化学习等 AI 技术在 Bot 行为决策中的应用，提升 Bot 智能表现、运行稳定性和多人对战体验；

title: ゲームAIリサーチインターン｜Game AI Research Intern 106377
jd_text:
部署紹介/Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS は、物語性の高いストーリー、没入感のあるゲームプレイ、最先端のテクノロジーを駆使し、ゲーム開発をアートとサイエンスの融合として追求し続けています。世界中のプレイヤー、そしてあらゆるデバイスに次世代のゲームエクスペリエンスを提供することを使命としています。
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center は、PUBG モバイルを始めとする様々な高品質ゲームを手掛けた Lightspeed Studios の研究開発部門です。Tech Center は技術研究とイノベーションを牽引し、ゲーム作品にそのライフサイクルを通して、エンジン、音響、QA、AI、次世代技術、技術提携などのテクニカルサポートを提供しています。
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
 仕事内容:
1.  ゲーム分野における強化学習（RL）アルゴリズムの実装・開発を行う。
2.  研究環境や実務環境におけるタスクに対して、RLモデルの訓練を行う。
3.  研究目標の達成に向けて、チームメンバーと積極的に協力する。
Job Responsibilities:
1.  Explore and develop novel reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms to address challenges in game contexts.
2.  Train RL models on innovative and practical tasks.
3.  Collaborate proactively with team members to achieve research goals.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募条件:
1.  PythonおよびPyTorchなどの主要フレームワークを用いたRLアルゴリズムの実装経験。
2.  強化学習モデルのチューニングや最適化する経験。
3.  英語に堪能であること（必須）。
4.  歓迎：協調型マルチエージェント強化学習、アドホックチームワーク、または人間とAIの協力に関する専門知識または経験。
5.  歓迎：NeurIPS、ICML、ICLRなどトップカンファレンスでの論文発表経験。
6.  歓迎：中国語または日本語のバイリンガル能力。

Requirements:
1.  Hands-on experience implementing RL algorithms in Python, using popular frameworks such as PyTorch.
2.  Must be able to tune and optimize reinforcement learning models.
3.  Must be proficient in English.
4.  Preferred: Familiarity with cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, ad-hoc teamwork, or human-AI cooperation technologies.
5.  Preferred: Experience publishing papers in top conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).
6.  Preferred: Bilingual proficiency in Chinese or Japanese.

年収額：応相談（昇給/賞与あり）

健康保険 、雇用保険、 労災保険、 厚生年金保険、 総合福祉団体定期保険（GTL）
業務災害安心総合保険（GPA）、団体長期障害所得補償保険（GLTD）

＜各種手当＞

title: (Senior) Cloud & AI Solution Architect
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Technical Consulting & Enablement: Provide professional services, including business technology consultation, cloud solution training, and technical enablement to support Tencent Cloud’s international business growth.
Solution Design & Migration: Collaborate with international architects and partners to design architecture on the Tencent Cloud platform. Guide customers and partners through system migration to the cloud, offering expertise in application and data migration, and supporting the development of applications and services on our platform.
Pre-sales & Project Coordination: Coordinate cross-functional resources from product, service, and operations teams to provide robust pre-sales technical support for key partner projects and strategic opportunities.
Ecosystem & Knowledge Development: Participate in building and structuring Tencent Cloud’s global technology partner ecosystem. Contribute by summarizing and documenting technical solutions and industry-specific use cases.

Who We Look For
Education & Core Experience: A Bachelor’s degree or higher, with over 5 years of hands-on experience in public or private cloud environments, and a solid understanding of technologies and solutions from major cloud providers.
Technical Breadth: Professional experience in at least two of the following domains: Software Development (proficient in Java, Python, or similar), System Operations & Maintenance, System Integration, Solution Design, Technical Consulting, Enterprise IT Systems & Architecture Management, Big Data, or AI.
Communication & Engagement: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and build trust with customer stakeholders at all levels—from business leaders and technical decision-makers to front-line engineers.
Mindset & Approach: A strong customer-centric mindset, a rigorous and detail-oriented work ethic, and a deep sense of responsibility. You are a proven self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and a proactive attitude.
Language Skills: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in a major European language (e.g., Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese) and/or Mandarin Chinese is a significant plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Netherlands-Amsterdam | UK-London

title: AI测试架构师
jd_text:
1.负责AI金融测试工具及平台的整体架构设计与迭代优化，打造高可用、可扩展的AI赋能测试基础设施；

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
Responsibilities
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.

title: AI Senior Research Scientist
jd_text:
Business Unit
Technology Engineering Group (TEG) is responsible for supporting the company and its business groups on technology and operational platforms, as well as the construction and operation of R&D management and data centers, TEG provides users with a full range of customer services. As the operator of the largest networking, devices, and data center in Asia,TEG also leads the Tencent Technology Committee in strengthening infrastructure R&D through internal and distributed open source collaboration, constructing new platforms and supporting business innovation.

What the Role Entails
Research and optimize content generation models (text, image, audio, 3D models, etc.) to address challenges such as generation quality, diversity, controllability, and efficiency.
Aim to improve user experience and production effectiveness, and support the productization of algorithms.
Conduct algorithm training and optimization in areas such as image generation, multi-modal large models, and few-shot learning.
Based on inhouse products and business needs, improve the performance and experience of AI painting, text generation, and video generation through: Prompt optimization / Generation model R&D / Adapter development / Performance acceleration which also includes resolving algorithm bottlenecks when applying models in real business scenarios.
Address the industrial deployment of multimodal generative models and actively explore model design and optimization in an R&D context

Who We Look For
PhD (preferably fulltime) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or related fields.
Solid foundation in computer vision or machine learning algorithms; candidates with publications in top conferences or journals are preferred.
Proficient in machine learning and deep learning fundamentals, and familiar with mainstream AIGC frameworks, including GAN, VAE, VQGAN, Diffusion models, etc.
Familiar with generation model extensions such as ControlNet, LoRA, and Text Inversion.
Familiar with multi-modal models like CLIP, ERNIE-ViL, and other transformer-based cross-modal representation models. Hands-on experience in NLP, multi-modal learning, or AI-generated content is a strong plus.
Strong learning ability, clear logical thinking, excellent communication skills, and a high level of curiosity.
Good teamwork and interpersonal communication skills.
Fluency in both English and Mandarin to deal with international stakeholders and stakeholders who are based in HQ

title: AI数据工程开发
jd_text:
1.负责云采购供应领域的 AI 数据与智能应用平台建设，围绕规划、采购、供应保障、库存与风险分析等场景，打造行业标杆 AI 产品，推动 AI 能力规模化落地；
2.围绕 AI 场景构建面向智能应用的数据体系，包括数据资产组织、业务语义建模、Schema 增强与知识沉淀等能力，使供应链数据能够被 AI Agent 和业务应用准确理解、高效消费；
3.推动数据与业务能力的服务化、标准化，建设统一的数据消费与工具调用能力，包括 API、MCP Tool、CLI、Skill、Workflow 等，实现能力的可调用、可组合与可复用；
4.主导复杂平台架构设计与关键技术方案落地，完善 AI Agent 编排、异步任务、服务治理与可观测性等工程能力，保障平台的稳定性、性能、安全性和可扩展性；
5.与云供应、采购及运营团队紧密协作，深入理解服务器与关键部件的业务场景和数据口径，将业务需求沉淀为平台化能力，持续推动云供应链 AI 产品与数据基础设施演进。
1.本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、数据科学等相关专业，能力突出者可适当放宽；
2.具备 5 年以上后端或平台研发经验，熟悉 Python，拥有扎实的编码、调试和系统设计能力；
3.熟悉数据库与数据处理，具备良好的 SQL 能力，能够理解复杂数据模型、指标口径及分析查询；

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect (Singapore)
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position OverviewTencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across APAC. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud's AI portfolio, including TokenHub, Tencent Hy foundation models, leading third-party Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem, you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Sales teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will act as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, bringing customer feedback into product evolution while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides unified access to Tencent Hy and leading third-party LLMs through a single API, together with enterprise-grade inference, monitoring, deployment, and model management capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
ResponsibilitiesPartner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, Tencent Hy foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI services.
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing solution performance in production environments.
Design scalable AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, and cloud-native AI services.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, influence product roadmap decisions, and continuously improve developer experience through real-world customer feedback.
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate AI adoption across enterprise customers and partners.
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For
Job RequirementsBachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of AI model deployment, inference services, and production operations.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.
#LI-LS1

title: AI数据产品经理
jd_text:
1.规划和落地AI驱动的数据产品/工具，如AI 数据智能体、AI 自动化埋点、大模型评测等，协同算法、研发、产品、运营等团队，完成需求调研、方案设计、原型输出、项目推进、验收上线和持续迭代；
2.围绕大模型业务场景，搭建完善的量化评测体系，通过数据分析定位模型短板、数据缺陷，输出优化方案并推动落地；
3.深入理解 AI 研发、数据生产、数据治理、数据消费等业务流程，抽象共性需求，设计平台化、标准化、可复用的产品方案；
4.关注 AI 数据产品方向的发展趋势，结合业务需求持续优化平台能力和产品体验。
1.本科以上学历，数据科学、数学、统计、运筹学、计算机、人工智能等相关专业；
2.严谨的逻辑思维能力和扎实的数理专业知识基础，掌握常见的统计分析、实验设计、机器学习等领域的基础理论；
3.具备基础数据分析能力，熟练使用 SQL，了解 Python 数据分析基础，能够通过数据复盘产品效果、定位问题、输出优化方案；
4.具备较强的结构化思维和抽象能力，能够将复杂业务流程拆解为清晰的产品模块、数据流程和权限关系；
5.掌握数据产品核心方法论，熟悉数仓基础、维度建模、ETL 流程、指标体系搭建，可独立完成需求拆解、方案设计、PRD 撰写、原型设计全流程工作；
6.熟悉大模型（LLM）和AI应用，具备Prompt工程、RAG、Agent等实践经验，能结合业务场景评估AI方案的价值和可行性；
7.有AI 数据产品、大数据产品、数据平台产品相关工作经验经验者优先；
8.沟通表达清晰；高效的协作能力；积极主动、自驱力强。

title: AI infra规划架构师
jd_text:
1.负责公司整体AI平台架构设计和AI工程化技术。通过AI基础设施和软硬件协同优化来提升公司大模型训练和推理的效率。负责前沿异构计算芯片、大模型推理优化、大规模训练的技术演进跟踪和落地。

title: AI大模型架构师
jd_text:
1.负责公司大模型（LLM/VLM/MoE等）的整体技术架构规划，参与千亿/万亿参数级别大模型的训练、推理全流程架构优化；
2.优化大规模分布式训练系统（3D并行、ZeRO优化等），参与解决断点续训、通信瓶颈、显存优化等技术难题，提升稳定性和降低成本；
3.规划公司AI基础设施，包括AI芯片、存储、通信等。参与大模型训练的全流程规划（数据处理、预训练、精调、强化、后训练等）。参与大模型推理的全流程规划（改写、压缩、多轮对话、Agent等）。
1.5年以上AI相关开发经验，包括不限于搜索、推荐、CV等。2年以上专注于大模型（GPT、Llama、Qwen、DeepSeek等系列）领域工作经验；

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Intern — AI Infrastructure 108158
jd_text:
About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails
Role Summary
We are seeking a motivated Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Intern to join our AI Compute team, supporting the daily operations of AI infrastructure. In this role, you will work closely with internal business teams and external engineering partners to build and operate AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on opportunity to gain knowledge and experience in  cutting-edge AI infrastructure.Key Responsibilities
Support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of high-performance AI infrastructure servers, storage servers, networking equipment, and software components in secure environments.
Assist with hardware diagnostics, system functionality checks, and firmware updates as required.
Collaborate with engineering teams to help deliver tailored customer environments (e.g., bare-metal systems, Kubernetes, Slurm, etc.).
Provide first-line engineering support for onsite operational issues, including troubleshooting hardware, network, and software problems, and firmware compliance.
Document incident details, resolutions, and lessons learned to improve future problem-solving.
Maintain clear, accurate, and up-to-date documentation to support knowledge sharing across the team.
Participate in team meetings and knowledge-sharing sessions to foster collaboration and continuous learning.

Who We Look For
Qualifications & RequirementsCurrently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
Basic understanding of server hardware, firmware lifecycle, and Linux environments, with an awareness of physical and system-level security standards.
Exposure to scripting languages such as Bash or Python.
Familiarity with — or strong interest in — configuration management, CI/CD tools, workload managers, and cluster software (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes), and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Professional fluency in English and Mandarin is highly preferred
Preferred QualificationsCoursework, projects, or hands-on experience related to AI Infrastructure, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure.
Familiarity with networking fundamentals and Linux system administration.
Genuine interest in AI/ML infrastructure.

Location State(s)
US-California-Palo Alto
The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $27.12 to $51.93 per hour. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related  knowledge, skills, and experience.
This position will be eligible for 1 hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked and up to 13 paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, full-time interns are also eligible to enroll in the Company-sponsored medical plan.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: US-California-Palo Alto

title: Tencent Cloud - AI Native Cloud Solution Architect (Thailand)
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
What You Can Do Here
1. Accelerate your growth with an international perspective, engage with top-tier Southeast Asia customers, and deeply participate in the most cutting-edge AI needs of the Southeast Asia market and the continuously evolving cloud industry solutions.
2. Master the latest cloud product capabilities in a full-stack manner — across IaaS, AI, audio/video, security and other product lines. Through project co-building with Southeast Asia customers, continuously improve human-AI collaboration capability and customer project success efficiency.
3. Work closely with a diverse, excellent team in Southeast Asia, and jointly embark on a rapidly changing high-growth journey.
Serve as the customer's technical consulting expert. Lead Tencent Cloud pre-sales analysis, bidding document authoring, and customer solution communication, and strive to obtain support from the customer's technical decision-making level.
Deeply explore and follow up on the landing of customer needs. Combined with Tencent Cloud public cloud, private cloud, container, big data, audio/video, AI and other product capabilities, design technical solutions for Thailand SVIP customers and follow up on delivery, continuously strengthening differentiated competitive advantages.
Possess an AI-Native perspective, be proficient in Tencent Cloud AI product knowledge and effectively promote it. Use AI capabilities to complete project POCs and demos, accelerate migration and delivery, and monitor SVIP customer business quality.
Promote scaled business growth in key markets. On a daily basis, collect real feedback and industry common needs from Thailand customers, and drive continuous iteration and optimization of cloud products and AI tools.

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above; majors in computer science, information technology, telecommunications engineering and other related fields are preferred.
5+ years of experience in cloud computing pre-sales or solution-related work, covering pre-sales research, bidding document authoring, POC implementation, delivery acceptance, and other project phases.
Familiar with mainstream public cloud platforms, such as Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc. Have experience using AI technology to assist and drive projects; familiar with at least one AI Agent application and have effectively applied it in work.
Extremely strong pressure resistance and resilience. Proactively tackle project technical risks and AI implementation challenges, with no shirking or escaping. Take real business results as the sole orientation, and refuse to stay only at paper-level solutions.
Excellent cross-cultural communication and collaboration ability; fluent English with no barriers to business communication; adapt to the collaboration rhythm of multi-country teams. Thai language proficiency is preferred.
Strong proactive collaboration awareness; willing to undertake cross-department collaborative work, with no division of work boundaries, and project success as the core goal.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Thailand-Bangkok

title: AI游戏本地化专家
jd_text:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1、AI Copilot 系统研发：负责本地化 AI Copilot 系统的架构设计与核心代码编写，实现 AI 辅助翻译、术语推荐、译后编辑（PE）等功能。
2、向量检索与 RAG 落地：负责向量数据库（Vector DB）的选型、搭建与优化；利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，将现有的翻译记忆库（TM）和术语库（TB）转化为向量，实现高召回、高精准的上下文检索。
3、主流大模型（LLM）接入与性能优化：负责将 Google Cloud（Vertex AI / Gemini）、OpenAI、Claude 等海外主流 AI 模型，通过 API 高效、稳定地接入公司现有的本地化作业平台与 CAT 自动化流水线；并解决大模型调用中的高并发、高延迟、API 限流等问题，优化 Token 消耗成本。
4、Prompt 工程与调优：主导面向多语种（特别是复杂语种，如韩语、泰语、缅甸语、西语等）的 Prompt 设计、微调与评估；通过 Few-shot、COT、Structured Output 等技术，确保 AI 翻译在字数限制、标签（Tag）保留、语气风格上达到工业级游戏本地化标准。
5、本地化 TMS 系统开发与运维：负责本地化 TMS 系统的新特性开发与已有功能的维护、性能优化，实现本地化流程自动化和全球应用。
6、本地化业务支持：理解游戏本地化流程与实践，利用 AI 与工具能力持续优化本地化效率与质量；后续可负责一到多款游戏的多语言本地化，与上游研发团队和发行团队沟通、制定整体本地化计划与预算、交付符合质量要求的本地化多语言版本。

岗位要求
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、语言类、本地化或相关专业，有3年以上实际开发经验。扎实的编程能力，熟练掌握 Python / Go / Node.js 中的至少一种开发语言，具备良好的编码规范。
2、大模型开发经验：熟悉 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等主流 LLM 开发框架，有实际的大模型 API（如 Google Vertex AI, OpenAI）对接与工程化落地经验。
3、向量数据库经验：熟悉至少一种向量数据库（如 Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma），理解向量嵌入（Embedding）原理，有 RAG 系统调优经验者优先；同事具备优秀的Prompt 能力，对 Prompt Engineering 有深入理解，能够熟练编写结构化 Prompt，并能通过自动评估或评测集不断迭代 Prompt 效果。
4、游戏本地化认知：了解游戏端内外内容的本地化流程和实践，有游戏本地化版本成功交付经验者优先；熟悉翻译、审校、 配音或LQA流程，对游戏本地化有独到的见解，善于利用工具和 AI 能力持续优化本地化效率和质量。
5、熟悉本地化业务：熟悉翻译记忆库（TMX）、术语表（TBX）、CAT 工具；具备MS office等本地化行业常见文档格式处理能力和经验者优先。
6、英语能力：书面或口头交流顺畅，能快速阅读英文技术文档，并与海外团队、供应商顺畅沟通。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。
Work Location: China-Shenzhen

title: Lead Game Development Expert, AI-Asset & Animation Production
jd_text:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a senior game development expert with deep AAA production experience to strengthen co-development and technical partnership between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios.
The successful candidate will bring a strong technical art and animation background, with a particular focus on asset production and animation workflows. Instead of covering the full breadth of art disciplines, this role concentrates on AI-enabled asset creation, asset performance optimisation, asset visual fidelity and on the animation side skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.Participate in co-development projects between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios, providing senior expertise in AI-enabled asset production, asset performance optimisation, asset visual quality, skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.
Make AI-driven asset and animation improvement a central pillar of technical collaboration. Identify concrete opportunities across the full asset lifecycle (modelling, texturing, materials, LODs, performance profiling) and animation disciplines (skeleton generation, skinning, control rigs, cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics and ragdoll setups).
Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept projects that integrate AI tools with existing asset authoring tools, animation rigging environments, physics engines, and Unreal Engine or equivalent game engines.
Evaluate the suitability, feasibility and expected value of AI solutions for asset and animation challenges. Define measurable metrics covering asset creation time, memory/performance budgets, visual fidelity, rigging speed, animation quality, physics stability and overall pipeline scalability.
Work closely with Art Directors, Technical Artists, Animators, Riggers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, Engineers, Producers and AI specialists to translate creative and production requirements into practical, measurable solutions focused on assets and animation.
Drive the transition of successful AI experiments into daily production workflows. Collect user feedback, refine asset and animation pipelines, and document repeatable implementation approaches for asset generation, optimisation, rigging automation and physics setup.
Establish human-review and quality-control mechanisms for AI-assisted asset and animation workflows, ensuring visual consistency, animation fidelity, physical plausibility, performance targets and intellectual property/data security are respected.
Lead technical investigations and solution designs for complex asset production challenges (e.g., automated LOD generation, material and texture optimisation, shader performance) and animation challenges (e.g., auto-rigging, physics-aware motion, real-time cloth simulation).
Bridge overseas studio requirements with Tencent’s internal AI capabilities, asset platforms, animation technology stacks and subject-matter experts.
Document reusable AI use cases, asset pipeline standards, rigging and physics best practices, performance guidelines and evaluation methods. Share knowledge through workshops, technical reviews and project retrospectives.
Monitor trends in generative AI, neural rendering, procedural content generation, machine learning for deformation and physics, digital humans and real-time graphics, assessing their practical value for AAA asset and animation production.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Graphics, Digital Media, Game Development, Art and Design, Animation, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
At least 8 years of professional experience in technical art, animation technology or a closely related discipline, with significant exposure to AAA asset and animation pipelines.
Experience operating as a Senior Technical Artist, Lead Technical Artist, Technical Art Director, Animation Pipeline Lead, Rigging Lead or equivalent senior role with a clear focus on assets and/or animation.
Proven development experience on a recognised AAA game project, including at least one shipped AAA title where you were directly responsible for asset optimisation, rigging, or physics-animation workflows.
Strong understanding of the complete AAA asset and animation lifecycle, from initial modelling and rigging, through version control and validation, to engine integration, performance profiling and runtime optimisation.
Strong interest in generative AI, machine learning and intelligent automation, especially as applied to asset generation, asset optimisation, auto-rigging, motion synthesis, deformation prediction and physics simulation.
Ability to identify high-value AI opportunities rooted in real asset and animation production challenges and progress them through proof-of-concept, workflow design, tool integration and production adoption.
Strong experience with Unreal Engine or another major game engine, including real-time rendering, asset management, animation blueprints, physics assets and cross-platform performance constraints.
Proficiency in Blender or Maya; working knowledge of Houdini is a plus.
Experience with tools development or workflow automation using Python, C++, Blueprint or equivalent, particularly for asset processing, rigging automation or physics pipeline tools.
Strong problem-solving, solution design and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance asset quality, animation expressiveness, engineering feasibility and production efficiency.
Excellent English communication skills, able to lead technical discussions, conduct solution reviews, prepare documentation and collaborate effectively in an international environment.
Willingness to work across regions and time zones and to travel to partner studios in Europe or other locations when required.

Deep expertise in several of the following areas:
​​(1) AAA asset production pipelines (characters, environments, props) with a strong emphasis on performance optimisation, memory budgets, LOD strategies and visual consistency.
(2) Asset visual quality and efficiency: material authoring, texture optimisation, shading models, draw call management and cross-platform asset validation.
(3) Skeleton design and character/creature rigging: hierarchical structures, joint placement, modular rig systems, and auto-rigging methods.
(4) Skinning and deformation: linear blend skinning, dual quaternion skinning, corrective blendshapes, muscle systems and deformation quality control.
(5) Physics-based animation: cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics, ragdoll setups, secondary motion, and real-time physics constraints in engine.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: United Kingdom-London

title: Tencent Cloud - AI Native Cloud Solution Architect (Thailand)
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
As a Senior Solution Architect at Tencent Cloud in Thailand, you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption and success of Tencent Cloud services in the region. This position requires a blend of technical acumen, customer-facing skills, and strategic thinking. You will work closely with clients and partners to understand their needs, develop tailored cloud solutions, and ensure successful implementation. Your expertise will contribute to shaping Tencent Cloud’s product offerings and go-to-market strategies, making a significant impact on the business landscape in Thailand.

What You Can Do Here
1. Accelerate your growth with an international perspective, engage with top-tier Southeast Asia customers, and deeply participate in the most cutting-edge AI needs of the Southeast Asia market and the continuously evolving cloud industry solutions.
2. Master the latest cloud product capabilities in a full-stack manner — across IaaS, AI, audio/video, security and other product lines. Through project co-building with Southeast Asia customers, continuously improve human-AI collaboration capability and customer project success efficiency.
3. Work closely with a diverse, excellent team in Southeast Asia, and jointly embark on a rapidly changing high-growth journey.Serve as the customer's technical consulting expert. Lead Tencent Cloud pre-sales analysis, bidding document authoring, and customer solution communication, and strive to obtain support from the customer's technical decision-making level.
Deeply explore and follow up on the landing of customer needs. Combined with Tencent Cloud public cloud, private cloud, container, big data, audio/video, AI and other product capabilities, design technical solutions for Thailand SVIP customers and follow up on delivery, continuously strengthening differentiated competitive advantages.
Possess an AI-Native perspective, be proficient in Tencent Cloud AI product knowledge and effectively promote it. Use AI capabilities to complete project POCs and demos, accelerate migration and delivery, and monitor SVIP customer business quality.
Promote scaled business growth in key markets. On a daily basis, collect real feedback and industry common needs from Thailand customers, and drive continuous iteration and optimization of cloud products and AI tools.

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above; majors in computer science, information technology, telecommunications engineering and other related fields are preferred.
5+ years of experience in cloud computing pre-sales or solution-related work, covering pre-sales research, bidding document authoring, POC implementation, delivery acceptance, and other project phases.
Familiar with mainstream public cloud platforms, such as Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc. Have experience using AI technology to assist and drive projects; familiar with at least one AI Agent application and have effectively applied it in work.
Extremely strong pressure resistance and resilience. Proactively tackle project technical risks and AI implementation challenges, with no shirking or escaping. Take real business results as the sole orientation, and refuse to stay only at paper-level solutions.
Excellent cross-cultural communication and collaboration ability; fluent English with no barriers to business communication; adapt to the collaboration rhythm of multi-country teams. Thai language proficiency is preferred.
Strong proactive collaboration awareness; willing to undertake cross-department collaborative work, with no division of work boundaries, and project success as the core goal.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Thailand-Bangkok

title: Tencent Cloud - Senior Solution Architect - Cloud & AI Solutions (Thailand)
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Cloud is seeking an experienced Senior Solution Architect to support enterprise pre-sales engagements and drive technical solution excellence. This role focuses on translating customer business requirements into scalable cloud architectures, leading proof-of-concept initiatives, and developing compelling technical proposals that enable successful deal conversion. You will collaborate closely with Sales, clients, and internal technical teams to design practical, high-impact cloud solutions while representing Tencent Cloud’s technical credibility in customer-facing engagements.
Responsibilities:
Prepare, execute, and oversee technical proof-of-concept activities to validate solution feasibility and business value, including AI-enabled cloud migration optimization to improve migration efficiency, reduce operational risks and optimize resource costs.

2.研究 AI 时代的新型安全风险与前沿技术，重点关注大模型、AI Agent、MCP、Agent Skills、AI 基础设施及供应链等方向，研究提示注入、Agent 异常行为、工具误用、敏感信息风险、权限越界、供应链风险等新型安全问题；
3.探索 AI Agent 驱动的自动化安全能力，利用 LLM、Reasoning Model、Agent、Tool Use、Multi-Agent 等技术，研发自动化漏洞发现、渗透测试、风险路径规划、漏洞验证等能力，持续提升安全工作的自动化和规模化水平；
4.建设面向真实业务的 AI 安全评测体系，沉淀漏洞案例、安全测试方法、Benchmark、评测数据和安全知识库，将安全专家经验转化为可复用、可持续迭代的 Agent 能力；
5.跟踪国内外前沿安全与 AI 技术发展，快速分析新漏洞、新型风险及 AI 安全问题，通过技术研究、原型验证和工程化落地，将前沿技术转化为实际安全能力；
6.与业务、安全研发、算法及平台团队紧密协作，对发现的问题进行风险分析和技术路径还原，帮助业务准确理解问题的实际影响，并推动高风险问题完成修复和体系化治理。
1.计算机、网络安全、人工智能或相关专业本科及以上学历；相比学历和工作年限，我们更关注实际安全能力、技术深度和持续学习能力；
2.具备扎实的安全技术基础，熟悉 Web、API、云原生、客户端、二进制等一个或多个方向的漏洞原理和安全测试技术，能够独立完成漏洞挖掘、渗透测试及复杂风险路径分析；
3.具备较强的自动化意识和工程能力，能够通过 Python / Go 等语言开发安全工具，将人工安全经验抽象为工具、规则、数据或自动化流程，而不仅限于手工安全测试；
4.对 LLM 和 AI Agent 有基本理解或浓厚兴趣，能够使用主流模型和 Agent 技术解决安全问题；具备 Prompt Engineering、Tool Use、RAG、Agent Harness、Multi-Agent 等相关实践经验者优先；
5.具备较强的研究和问题抽象能力，能够面对未知安全问题快速完成信息收集、技术分析、实验验证，并形成新的安全测试方法、检测能力或自动化能力；

4.熟悉 GPU / NPU 资源管理（设备插件、共享 / 虚拟化、拓扑调度）与高性能网络（RDMA / RoCE、CNI 定制）；有主流推理框架（vLLM / TensorRT-LLM / SGLang）集成经验者优先；

6.有大规模 K8s 集群、多租户算力平台，或存储 / 网络 / 调度器二次开发落地经验；
7.具备昇腾 / 海光 / 天数等国产 AI 芯片云原生适配与优化经验；
8.主导或深度参与开源云原生项目（Kubernetes / Volcano / KubeFlow 等）并有社区贡献。

1.构建游戏模型评测体系：通过紧跟先进模型及应用的前沿发展，设计全面、准确的多维度指标，建立覆盖多模态（文本/语音/图像/视频/3D等）生成、多模态理解等全面、多维度的评测体系；
2.构建游戏模型评测流程：协同多方相关团队梳理并构建游戏模型评测流程，定期监控模型效果，分析问题并提供优化方案，把模型评测流程高效落地；
3.积极洞察行业动态：持续完善评测体系、快速反馈行业动态及模型能力，发现行业模型以及应用的前进方向、亮点；
4.结果归因：通过各种数据分析方法，深度分析模型评测结果，为模型的更新调优提供精准的问题分析结论。
1.计算机等相关专业硕士或以上学历，对大模型和游戏都有深度了解；
2.了解大模型的基本原理和评测方法，能设计合理的评测指标和评测流程；
3.具备数据分析能力，能从评测结果中提炼规律、定位问题根因、输出可执行的优化建议；
4.有评测系统或质量保障系统的开发经验，能独立设计自动化评测流水线；
5.具备 Python 工程能力，熟悉常用数据分析和可视化工具；
6.逻辑严谨，注重细节，能在主观评价与量化指标之间找到平衡；
7.拥有出色的沟通协调能力、严谨的逻辑思维能力与深度数据分析能力，善于发现问题并提出系统性解决方案，具备良好的团队协作精神。

title: AI智能体评测高级工程师
jd_text:
1.负责腾讯自研龙虾WorkBuddy/腾讯AI IDE CodeBuddy产品质量保障及AI评测工作，推动产品质量体系，生成效果提升；
2.负责大语言模型（LLM）及Agent系统的评测体系设计与持续演进，覆盖模型能力评测、Agent任务评测、端到端产品功能评测等，构建Benchmark；
3.跟踪业界评测基准动态（如 SWE-bench、HumanEval、MMLU、AgentBench 等），结合业务场景进行适配与创新；

2.熟练掌握 Python，具备脚本开发与数据处理能力；熟悉业界主流LLM评测基准与方法论（HumanEval、SWE-bench、MMLU、GSM8K等）；
3.了解大语言模型的基本原理（Transformer架构、预训练、微调、RLHF、推理优化等）。有主流深度学习框架（PyTorch / TensorFlow / JAX）的实践经验者优先；
4.具备Agen开发或测试经验，了解ReAct、Function Calling、Tool Use、Planning等核心概念；
5.有评测平台或自动化测试框架的开发经验者优先；具备数据分析能力，能从评测数据中提炼有价值的洞察。

title: 游可爱-AI全栈开发工程师
jd_text:
1.负责游可爱双域及小程序端的前端功能开发，实现B端中后台与C端业务页面的高质量交付；

6.攻坚前端性能优化与复杂交互场景（如达人智选、数据看板、Agent应用），提升用户体验与系统响应能力；
7.践行团队AI工程化（Harness/CodeBuddy），通过AI Agent覆盖需求拆解、页面生产、接口对接、自测发布全流程，并与TAPD需求/缺陷联动提效；

1.本科及以上学历，计算机相关专业，3年以上前端开发经验（可根据能力适当调整）；

3.熟练掌握Vue框架（含响应式原理、组件化设计），有大型中后台/B端复杂业务前端开发经验者优先；
4.熟悉Monorepo+pnpm工程组织模式，掌握Vite/Rspack等现代构建工具的使用与优化；
5.具备良好的接口对接能力，理解前后端协议协作逻辑（了解Protobuf/PB协议自动化实践者优先）；
6.拥有主人翁意识与需求模块负责人心态，能独立负责一个业务模块的全流程开发；具备良好的产研沟通能力，可与产品、后端、测试团队高效协同推进项目；
7.具备大模型应用开发经验，理解 Agent RAG Function Calling MCP Workflow 的原理与工程实现，能围绕业务场景独立设计并落地 AI 能力；
8.对 AI 能力边界、事实校验、幻觉风险、敏感动作控制、结果可解释性有基本认知，能在实现中设计相应校验与约束机制；

title: Generative AI Researcher (3D, Video, and Agentic Intelligence) 106420
jd_text:
Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
● Develop cutting-edge AI systems for 3D object and scene generation, video generation (world modeling), human motion capture and generation, multimodal vision-language models (VLM), and agentic reinforcement learning systems, tailored for next-generation game development.
● Conduct original research in computer vision, computer graphics, and embodied intelligence, driving innovation in generative AI pipelines for virtual world creation.
● Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams — including game developers, artists, and designers — to integrate AI-generated content seamlessly into gameplay experiences.
● Continuously explore and apply the latest research trends in 3D generation, video understanding, multimodal reasoning, and simulation-based RL to enhance production efficiency and creativity in games.

Who We Look For
● PhD degree in Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field.
● Strong research background in at least one of the following areas:
– 3D Object or Scene Generation
– Video Generation / World Modeling
– Human Motion Capture or Generation
– Vision-Language Models (VLM)
– Reinforcement Learning / Agentic AI
● Publications in top-tier conferences or journals (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, SIGGRAPH Asia, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, PAMI, IJCV, TOG, TVCG, etc.).
● Proficiency in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and experience in large-scale model training or evaluation.
● Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, research-driven environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
● Hands-on experience with 3D modeling or rendering tools (Blender, Unreal Engine, Unity, etc.).
● Strong coding and prototyping ability in Python, C++, or similar languages.
● Familiarity with datasets and benchmarks related to 3D, motion, or video generation.
● Proven ability to translate research results into real-world interactive applications.
● Creativity and a passion for developing the next generation of AI-driven content creation tools

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

jd_text:
1.参与 AI 原生游戏引擎的内核研发，设计并演进面向 Agent 的引擎能力；
2.负责渲染、场景、资产、物理、动画等引擎子系统的设计与实现；
3.参与引擎编辑器及可观测、调试、工具链的设计与开发，支撑 AI 与人的高效开发；
4.保障引擎的工程质量与性能，跟踪前沿技术生态。
1.计算机科学、软件工程等相关专业，3 年以上游戏引擎开发经验；扎实的算法、数据结构、操作系统、计算机网络等基础；
2.精通至少一门系统级语言（Rust / C++ / C 优先），并具备良好的 TypeScript 工程能力；良好的代码风格与软件工程素养；
3.深入理解游戏引擎架构，至少熟悉一款引擎的内核实现（自研引擎 / Unreal / Unity 等），理解渲染循环、ECS、资产管线、场景图等核心机制；
4.具备图形学基础：熟悉现代图形 API（WebGPU / Vulkan / D3D12 / Metal 其一）与可编程管线、着色器（WGSL / HLSL / GLSL），理解 PBR、渲染管线、GPU 资源与同步；
5.良好的数学与英文阅读功底，能快速阅读并理解前沿技术论文与开源代码；
6.良好的沟通协作能力，对解决挑战性问题充满热情；
7.对「AI × 游戏引擎」的结合有强烈兴趣与探索欲。

title: 腾讯云-AI Infra异构计算产品经理
jd_text:
1.负责面向AI推理场景的异构计算产品定义和规划，制定AI推理场景下的模型调优和业务部署应用平台规划，助力业务推理效率提升；
2.负责高性能训练集群产品规划工作，提升大规模AI分布式训练场景的平台加速、易用性和可观测性等产品能力；
3.持续跟踪人工智能市场发展及行业技术趋势，制定产品的长期规划；
4.指导或协助客户解决AI业务使用异构计算产品遇到的各种问题，发掘客户使用产品的潜力，输出产品解决方案。
1.本科以上学历，计算机、人工智能、数学等相关专业；
2.5年以上B端产品经理经验，有AI项目及云计算领域经验者优先；
3.熟悉数据中心GPU产品，对AI框架（Pytorch, TensorFlow等）有基本了解或使用经验，了解各类组件和库在推荐系统/CV/NLP/ASR等应用场景中的使用特点和优劣，能指导客户完成业务部署，初步分析性能瓶颈，解决各种业务层面的问题；
4.有云厂商AI产品经理经验者优先；
5.有一定的管理能力，具备丰富的产品规划和设计经验，对AI技术及行业有前瞻性战略思考；
6.清晰的逻辑分析和表达能力，乐观积极，具有较强的责任心和执行力。

title: 企业微信-企业客户AI解决方案
jd_text:
1.客户调研与场景挖掘：深入中腰部客户业务一线，调研真实业务流程与痛点，从中识别能用 AI 解决的高频场景；
2.AI 方案交付落地：基于企业微信+AI能力（智能表格、机器人、workbuddy等）完成方案配置与上线，对使用和转化等交付结果负责；
3.打法沉淀与批量复制：把单点客户的成功打法提炼成标准化方案包和交付SOP，推动中腰同行业客户的高效、批量复制；
4.转化协同：配合网销/商务团队，用AI 场景案例支撑批量转化（商业产出、方案讲解、标杆案例、直播出镜等）；
5.Al 能力反哺：沉淀客户侧高频 AI需求，反哺内部产品与方案迭代。
1.要求；
2.本科及以上学历，2年以上B 端客户成功、解决方案或交付实施经验，有 SaaS/企业服务批量交付经验者优先；
3.有 Al sense：日常高频使用AI工具解决真实工作问题，理解大模型/Agent能力边界，能快速判断结合落地；
4.场景挖掘能力强：能通过访谈和数据分析快速摸清一个陌生行业的业务流程，从杂乱需求中识别共性场景；
5.动手落地能力强：能独立完成产品配置、Prompt调试、简单接口排障，把方案装进客户业务里；
6.多客户并行管理能力强，节奏感好，适应线上线下高频次客户沟通；
7.沟通直接，能把技术语言翻译成客户听得懂的业务语言。

title: 腾讯金融-AI Agent 研发高级工程师
jd_text:
1.负责 Agent 核心能力设计研发和平台建设，包括 插件框架、调试与评测工具链、可观测；
2.负责系统性能、推理效果、服务稳定性与 Agent 安全治理（Prompt Injection 防御、沙箱隔离、工具调用审计），确保 Agent 产品具备规模化落地条件；
3.负责Agent 、Skill等端到端观测、评测、诊断、优化的闭环评测体系；
4.持续追踪 Agent 领域前沿进展，评估并引入有潜力的技术方案，建立技术影响力。
1.本科及以上学历，4年及以上开发经验，具备扎实的计算机基础和良好的代码能力，熟悉 Python / TypeScript / Go 中至少一种编程语言；
2.有 AI Agent 或 LLM 应用的实际开发和优化经验，熟悉主流 Agent 框架，深入理解 Agent运行核心机制；
3.负责评测体系架构和分层评测指标设计，具备 Badcase 归因与推动迭代能力；
4.具备评测体系建设经验，能设计分层评测指标，能对 Badcase 进行分析并推动迭代；
5.熟悉云原生、分布式系统等工程体系，能够独立完成系统设计、模块开发与系统优化；
6.理解 LLM 原理（Transformer、Attention 机制），熟悉主流推理框架（vLLM、SGLang等）。

title: 光子 AI-大语言模型Coding算法专家
jd_text:

2.提升Code Agent在代码能力、指令遵循、长程任务执行等方向上的核心能力；

2.扎实的深度学习算法基础，熟悉深度学习框架和分布式训练推理加速；
3.出色的问题分析和解决能力，能深入解决大模型训练和应用存在的问题；
4.责任心强，良好的业务意识，团队合作能力和沟通协调能力。

title: 光子 AI-推理部署与优化研究员
jd_text:
1.推动基于Diffusion的视频模型推理时效率优化；
2.针对消费级显卡优化推理 pipeline，目标实现端侧高效生成；
3.设计高并发推理服务，实现多模型路由与灰度发布；
4.建设端到端超低延迟管线，融合硬件加速编解码；
5.研发高效视频编码配置，适配实时流媒体协议；
6.跟踪最新加速方法，探索投机式扩散采样与训推一体优化。
1.硕士及以上学历，系统/AI 推理或音视频流媒体方向；
2.精通 TensorRT/vLLM 等推理框架，熟悉量化、剪枝、蒸馏，有家用级显卡部署经验；
3.熟悉扩散模型推理特点，有视频模型推理优化或云游戏系统优化经验者优先；
4.精通视频编解码原理，熟练使用 ffmpeg 及硬件加速编解码 SDK；
5.熟悉实时流媒体传输协议，有低延迟音视频传输系统研发经验；
6.有 FlashAttention/FlashInfer 源码级优化经验者优先；
7.关注前沿 AI 系统研究，在系统或 AI 顶会（如 MLSys, ASPLOS, OSDI, NeurIPS 等）有推理系统架构设计、CUDA 算子级优化或大模型/扩散模型加速相关方向论文发表记录者优先。

title: 光子 AI-3D 内容合成数据研究员
jd_text:
1.基于 UE5/Unity/Houdini/Blender 搭建合成数据生产管线，完成场景配置、相机轨迹、灯光等全流程开发；
2.实现 procedural content generation 批量生产场景，构建 3D 资产管理系统；
3.自动导出引擎数据：GBuffer、语义分割、3D primitives、相机参数、optical flow 等，输出多视角同步采集数据；
4.优化批量渲染效率，建立合成资产复用机制，降低单条视频成本；
5.跟踪业界合成数据做法，探索 sim2real domain randomization 在视频生成中的应用。
1.硕士及以上学历，图形学、游戏开发或 3D 视觉方向；
2.精通 UE5/Unity，能进行 Blueprint/C++/脚本级别开发；
3.熟悉渲染管线，理解 GBuffer 数据结构；
4.有批量化数据生成或 PCG 经验，熟练使用 Python/PyTorch；

jd_text:

6.稳定性建设：负责所属模块崩溃、ANR、卡顿等线上问题的定位、复盘与修复，沉淀稳定性治理经验；

title: 腾讯云-AI产品安全能力测试工程师
jd_text:
1.负责 WorkBuddy 等 AI Agent 产品及安全沙箱的安全能力评测工作，开展漏洞挖掘、渗透测试与安全评估，输出评测报告与修复建议；
2.跟踪 AI 系统与沙箱的主流漏洞原理与利用方式，独立完成对提示注入、模型越权、沙箱逃逸、代码/命令执行隔离等场景的漏洞分析与验证（PoC/EXP 编写）；
3.针对 AI Agent 开展安全评测，研究提示注入、Agent 操控、数据外泄、供应链投毒（技能/插件）等风险，参与攻防对抗与防护能力建设；
4.研究安全沙箱的检测与隔离机制，探索通用绕过方法（沙箱逃逸、隔离突破、恶意指令拦截绕过等），持续提升评测深度与覆盖面；
5.建设与优化安全评测工具链与自动化用例库，结合 AI 能力提升漏洞挖掘与评测的自动化水平和效率；
6.建立横向评测基准（固定评测集 vs 友商同类产品），跟踪业界最新攻防技术、0day/Nday 动态及安全顶会研究成果，沉淀为团队方法论与能力。

2.熟练使用常见漏洞利用工具及二进制逆向分析工具（如 IDA、WinDbg、GDB、x64dbg 等）；
3.熟悉 Python、Go 等至少一门编程语言，具备独立编写安全工具、PoC/EXP 脚本的能力；
4.熟悉容器、虚拟化与进程隔离机制（namespace/cgroup、seccomp、Docker 等），了解沙箱逃逸的常见路径；
5.熟悉常见 AI 漏洞原理（提示注入、越狱）与 RASP 原理，具备相关挖掘经验；有熟练运用 AI 提升评测效果与效率经验者优先。

title: AI 原生多模数据库内核研发工程师
jd_text:
1.多模存储与智能表架构设计： 负责多模态数据（向量、文本、文件等）高并发、大容量存储引擎架构设计，研发多模态统一智能路由表结构（Smart Table/Multi-Modal Schema）与高效持久化存储机制；
2.融合计算与查询优化： 设计并实现跨模态融合查询执行引擎，优化标量+向量混合过滤、多模态联合检索等复杂算子的下推、算子融合与并行执行路径，降低查询延迟并提升吞吐；
3.AI 负载与分布式计算下沉： 针对大模型多模态检索等 AI 工作负载，深度优化内存管理与多级缓存策略；探索与 Ray 等 AI 计算框架及大数据计算引擎的下沉融合计算，提升海量数据实时检索与分析性能；
4.架构演进与技术攻关： 推动多模态数据库内核向存算分离、Serverless 弹性扩展演进；攻克高并发写入下的索引实时更新、降低尾部延迟（Tail Latency）等关键工程难题，保持产品技术领先性。
1.专业背景： 计算机、软件工程等相关专业本科及以上学历，3 年以上数据库内核、分布式存储、搜索引擎或大数据核心计算/存储引擎（如 Spark, Flink, ClickHouse, Iceberg 等）研发经验；
2.核心技能： 精通 C/C++ 或 Rust，具备扎实的系统编程与底层调优能力，熟悉 Linux 操作系统内核、多线程编程、并发控制、内存管理及 CPU/硬件加速技术（如 SIMD/AVX512）；
3.领域知识： 深入理解 OpenSearch / Elasticsearch / Lucene 或主流向量搜索引擎（如 Milvus, FAISS 等）的实现原理与源码；对 HNSW/IVF 等向量索引算法及文本/全文检索有实际研发与性能调优经验者优先；
4.生态与计算框架： 具备开源大数据生态（如 Spark, Flink, Iceberg, ClickHouse 等）底层源码级开发或社区贡献经验者优先；熟悉 Ray 等分布式 AI 计算框架内核，或具备大规模异构资源调度与计算下推实战经验者优先。

jd_text:
1.：面向金融风控和合规履职，深入理解业务场景，提炼数据逻辑和口径，与相关方配合完成数据项目交付，同时探索利用大模型和AI技术提升数据交付效率（如智能需求解读、代码生成辅助、自动化报表生成等）；
2.：参与部门大数据体系设计，包括数据标准与规范制定、数据资产管理、开发运营工具建设、数据治理推进等，推动AI能力与数据平台的深度融合，提升数据开发效率和交付质量；
3.：规划和落地AI驱动的数据产品/工具，如智能风控数据洞察、合规知识问答、异常交易模式识别辅助等，与业务、策略模型、合规、研发等多个团队合作将大模型能力转化为业务可用的产品功能。
1.：了解数仓架构，熟悉数据开发和治理流程，熟练应用SQL语言；
2.：有数据产品策划运营经验，具备良好的逻辑思维和数据分析能力、优秀的沟通与项目管理能力，心态平稳、乐观积极、责任心强；
3.：熟悉大模型（LLM）和AI应用，具备Prompt工程、RAG、Agent等实践经验，能结合业务场景评估AI方案的价值和可行性；
4.：有金融行业相关从业经验加分，如反洗钱、支付、风控、金融合规等；
5.：岗位需具备一定技术背景，欢迎目前是开发但有志于转产品发展的同学投递。

title: 腾讯云-私有化解决方案架构师（AI Buddy方向）
jd_text:
1.岗位职责；
2.私有化方案设计与价值传递：负责WorkBuddy与CodeBuddy产品的私有化商业策划与售前技术支持。深入理解客户本地IT基础设施与网络隔离环境，腾讯TCS底座体系为金融、政务、医疗、工业、消费电子、零售、出行等多行业客户定制化设计高可用、安全合规的私有化部署方案，并向客户清晰阐述技术价值与业务优势；
3.全流程售前攻坚：与销售团队紧密协同，主导从客户需求调研、技术交流、私有化POC测试、方案设计到投标签约的全流程工作，对产品私有化销售收入与市场份额增长负责；
4.技术演示与资产沉淀：深入研究产品在各类底座上的部署架构、功能特性及应用场景，独立完成适配客户网络环境的私有化产品演示与解决方案设计，持续沉淀私有化售前技术方案、部署手册及标准化交付物；
5.产品迭代驱动：与产品研发团队保持紧密协作，及时传递私有化场景下的市场需求与客户反馈（如底座适配性、客户IT环境兼容性等），驱动产品持续迭代与优化。
1.岗位要求；
2.学历与经验：计算机科学、软件工程或相关专业本科及以上学历，3年以上售前、架构师或技术咨询经验；至少熟悉一个行业（如金融、政务、医疗、工业、消费电子、传媒、泛互联网、游戏等）的业务流程与技术架构，有大型客户私有化项目交付经验者优先；
3.技术栈要求：掌握至少一种主流编程语言（如Java/Python/Go），熟悉DevOps流程与CI/CD工具链（如Jenkins、GitLab CI、ArgoCD等）；了解AI Coding类产品（如CodeBuddy、Cursor、Claude Code）及OpenClaw等AI应用工具的原理与集成方式；
4.私有化部署核心能力：熟悉常见AI应用的私有化产品架构与工作原理，具备丰富的企业级私有化解决方案设计经验；能够针对客户复杂的IT环境（包括网络隔离、安全合规、算力资源、异构硬件等）进行架构适配与方案设计；
5.云原生底座体系认知：具备以下两类底座体系的实战经验（满足其一即可，两者兼备优先）：；
6.腾讯体系：了解腾讯TCS（Tencent Cloud-native Suite）底座体系或相关专有云基础设施，具备基于TCS进行应用部署、运维管理或方案整合的经验；
7.开源体系：深入理解Kubernetes架构与生态，熟悉主流发行版或管理平台，具备基于开源体系完成应用容器化部署、网络策略配置、存储对接及运维监控的实战经验；
8.综合素质：具备出色的沟通、表达与演讲能力，能够清晰地向客户与合作伙伴传达复杂技术方案，并协调多方资源推进项目落地。

title: 元宝-AI搜索算法工程师（大模型后训练方向）
jd_text:
1.负责AI搜索中大模型后训练方向的核心技术研发、优化与创新，优化Post-training 算法的训练效率和回复效果；
2.研究各领域高质量数据的自动化合成方法，建设高效的线上数据飞轮链路；
3.跟踪AI搜索领域的前沿技术，参与前沿算法研究，推动研究成果在业务场景的落地应用；
4.参与产品讨论，基于技术对产品提出改进建议。
1.计算机科学、人工智能等相关专业硕士及以上学历；
2.具备良好的LLM技术基础，熟练使用深度学习训练和推理框架，深入理解Transformer、GPT等模型架构；
3.在Post-training方向有一定研究基础，熟悉SFT/DPO/PPO/GRPO/Reward Model等；熟悉数据合成技术；
4.具备良好的分析和解决问题的能力，针对具体的应用场景能合理设计和优化算法并应用；
5.有相关领域顶会论文者优先。

title: AI协作工具产品后台研发高级工程师岗位
jd_text:
1.产品需求研发 + 基础架构研发工程师，综合角色；
2.负责AI协作工具产品用户端产品需求研发工作，包括技术基建、研发效能提升、全局架构优化，产品需求开发等工作；
3.负责AI协作工具产品用户端后台功能开发和性能优化。
1.本科以上学历，计算机相关专业，5 年以上 Golang/C/C++ 分布式系统开发经历；
2.责任心强、抗压能力强，有较强的逻辑思维、学习、沟通能力，工作能全局闭环；
3.热爱技术，有较强的学习意愿与能力，具备良好的分析解决问题能力，能独立承担任务，有项目进度把控能力；
4.熟悉多进程多线程编程，熟悉 TCP/IP，熟悉 Linux 网络编程和高并发，高可用设计范式；
5.熟悉 MySQL 数据库，NoSQL 存储，Kafka 等中间件；
6.熟悉常用的开源组件，包括 K8S 集群的搭建与运维，各种存储中间件的搭建与运维，并了解其内部原理。

title: 《无畏契约》-前端开发工程师-（AI & 创新互动方向）
jd_text:
1.多端体验与AI营销迭代：负责线上游戏官网、活动页、小程序及 AI 驱动的个性化营销/互动模块 的开发与维护，保障跨设备（PC/移动）流畅度与体验一致性；
2.线下沉浸式与AIGC互动开发：负责营销及电竞等线下场景的创新体验开发，结合 AIGC、视觉互动及智能音/视频 等前沿技术提升玩家沉浸感；
3.桌面端生态：负责 PC 客户端场景页面（含基于 Electron 开发的内嵌页面）的前端开发与长期迭代维护；
4.AI 赋能工程化体系：推进前端工程化建设，构建高效组件库与自动化工具，积极引入/探索 AI 工具链（如 Code Copilot、AI Code Review 等）提升团队全流程开发效率与代码质量；
5.跨团队紧密协作：与后端、设计、产品及 AI 工程/算法团队 紧密协作，完成接口对接、数据交互逻辑实现及创新需求的敏捷落地；
6.性能与稳定性保障：持续优化用户端加载速度与响应效率，解决多终端兼容性问题，保障高并发场景下的系统高可用。
1.计算机相关专业本科及以上学历，1年以上前端开发经验 ；
2.精通 Web 标准，熟练运用 HTML5/CSS3、JavaScript/TypeScript 构建高性能 PC/移动端页面及小程序；
3.熟悉基于 Electron 的桌面应用开发，具有实际项目开发与性能/体验优化经验，对跨平台渲染机制有深入理解；
4.熟练掌握至少一种主流前端框架（Vue.js/React/Angular），具备实际项目落地经验并理解框架底层原理 ；
5.扎实的 JavaScript/TypeScript 基础，熟练运用 ES6 + 语法，具备模块化、工程化开发思维 ；
6.至少熟悉一门后端语言（GO/PHP/Node.js 等），有接口联调经验，能独立解决前后端协作问题；
7.熟悉 AI 工具链与开发范式：熟练在日常研发中使用AI 工具提效，理解基于 Prompt Engineering 与大模型 API 的常见前端交互逻辑；
8.具备扎实的工程化思维，熟悉至少一门后端语言（如 Node.js / Go / PHP 等），有接口联调经验，能独立解决前后端协作问题；
9.熟悉移动端适配方案与前端性能优化策略（资源压缩、预加载、缓存机制、监控报表等）；
10.对游戏行业充满热情，逻辑清晰，具备良好的跨团队沟通表达能力与抗压能力。

title: 光子 AI-模型数据算法专家/负责人-数据方向
jd_text:
1.作为模型数据团队的技术负责人，统筹数据治理到模型训练之间的衔接工作，制定数据标准、质量规范和团队技术路线；
2.数据特征算法：负责海量文本&多模态数据（图像，视频，音频，3D）的内容理解（如分类标签体系、embedding表征、Caption生成等），质量检测（低质识别检测、优质美学评价等），去重/聚类分析，数据合成等算法；
3.数据管线建设：负责数据采集、筛选清洗、标注与质量评估管线建设。与模型业务团队紧密配合，充分分析挖掘数据资源，建立自动化数据处理流程与机制，支持模型持续迭代；
4.数据实验分析：对模型训练数据进行详细分析，建立科学数据实验机制，识别样本不足、质量问题、配比不均衡等潜在问题，驱动数据优化提升数据覆盖、质量、多样性需求，最终带来大模型生成效果的持续提升；
5.带领并指导团队成员，制定工作计划、评审技术方案、把控交付质量。
1.硕士及以上学历，计算机视觉、自然语言处理或多模态方向背景优先，5 年以上模型数据相关工作经验，有团队管理或技术 lead 经验；
2.熟练掌握深度学习框架（如PyTorch、TensorFlow），熟悉模型训练及数据处理经验，具备优秀的独立开发与分析调研能力；
3.具备大规模数据处理能力，熟悉 Spark/Ray/Flink 等分布式框架，有 TB/PB 级数据处理实践；
4.具备数据质量方法论：能定义质量标准、设计评估体系、建立自动化质量监控；
5.优秀的跨团队协作和推动能力，能将模型需求转化为数据工程方案并落地执行；
6.有技术视野，能持续跟踪业界 AI 数据最佳实践并引入团队。

title: Miora-资深 AI 工具链研发工程师-游戏技术方向
jd_text:
1.负责 AI 工具与资产处理链路的设计、工程实现和持续优化；
2.建设面向实际业务任务的能力评测体系，完成指标设计、测试集建设、技术选型与效果验证；
3.负责不同技术能力的接入、前后处理、参数配置、异常恢复和质量控制；
4.参与游戏资产规格、数据结构和工程交付协议的设计，提升上下游协作效率；
5.完成相关资产和工具在游戏运行环境中的验证，并根据实际问题持续优化处理链路；
6.推动 AI 能力与现有平台、工作流及游戏研发流程的稳定集成。
1.5 年以上研发经验，具备游戏工具链、引擎中台、技术美术研发或游戏资产平台相关经历；
2.具备 AI 原生产品实战，主导或深度参与过视觉模型或生成式 AI 工具从能力验证到产品上线的完整过程；
3.熟悉分割、抠图与透明化、超分、深度估计、姿态与骨骼估计等视觉能力，能够判断主流方案的适用场景和失效边界；
4.具备模型评测、技术选型和 Pipeline 编排能力，能设计测试集与指标，并处理前后处理、失败恢复和质量控制；
5.熟悉游戏资产生产与交付流程，理解 2D / 3D 资产、动画、界面、地图、材质等内容进入游戏工程时的关键规格；
6.具备较强的架构和产品化能力，能够将技术能力封装成稳定、可配置、可复用的生产工具，并独立推动完整交付。

title: 腾讯游戏平台-AI算法研究员-新星引力计划
jd_text:
1.结合游戏平台业务垂直场景，负责深度学习和大语言模型的训练精调、调优及部署，及智能体Agent开发；
2.参与大规模平台用户行为数据集的ETL及特征工程，构建高效数据流水线，落地到用户画像体系并服务到线上AI应用；
3.跟踪和研究前沿AI技术（如LLM、VLM、SFT、DPO、RAG、MCP等），推动技术落地业务发挥价值；
4.与技术团队协作，优化算法模型和服务性能，满足产品AI价值落地要求。
1.计算机科学、人工智能或数学专业硕士及以上学历，1-3年机器学习或深度学习、LLM/VLM相关开发经验，熟悉经典模型和优化算法；
2.扎实的机器学习基础和LLM底层核心架构；
3.具备一定大语言模型应用的模型微调和优化经验，如幻觉问题解决思路提炼和有效落地；
4.熟悉Linux开发环境和Python语言，了解PyTorch/TensorFlow框架；
5.良好的沟通能力和团队协作精神，能够清晰表达复杂技术概念，具备解决复杂问题的能力，善于创新思考；
6.喜欢游戏并具备一定游戏经验。

title: AI记忆系统研发专家/工程师（上海/北京/深圳）
jd_text:
1.设计研发Agent记忆系统，涵盖多种记忆类型（如core memory、episodic memory、semantic memory、procedural memory等等），理解不同记忆类型的适用场景和交互方式；
2.构建记忆的写入、整合与检索 pipeline：从原始对话或多模态输入中提取关键信息，进行去重、合并、冲突消解，并以高效方式存储和索引；
3.实现记忆的生命周期管理机制，包括记忆衰减、过期淘汰、重要性排序，以及基于使用频率或时间的动态权重调整；
4.搭建混合检索系统，结合向量和文本检索，支持对话上下文感知的记忆召回；
5.设计多智能体协作架构，让不同的memory agent各司其职（如用户画像agent、事件记录agent、知识图谱agent），通过 meta-agent 进行统一调度；
6.支持多模态记忆输入，处理文本、图像、公式等类型信息，并统一编码进记忆系统；
7.构建记忆系统的评估体系 —— 如何衡量记忆的准确性、召回率、时效性以及对下游任务的提升效果。
1.本科及以上学历，计算机相关专业，1年以上工作经验，精通Python/Go/C++等至少一门语言；
2.有Agent memory系统的实际开发经验，理解记忆系统的架构设计、存储策略和检索优化；
3.熟悉 LLM agent 框架生态（如 LangChain、LlamaIndex、Letta/MemGPT、AutoGen 等），理解 agent 如何与记忆模块交互；
4.对认知科学中的记忆模型有基本了解（episodic/semantic/procedural memory），能够将这些概念工程化落地；
5.有向量数据库/索引库的实践经验（如Milvus、Qdrant、Faiss等），熟悉向量模型的选型和优化；
6.具备良好的系统设计能力，较强的问题解决与团队协作能力；具备强烈的技术好奇心和自驱力，渴望在技术深度与广度上持续突破。

title: AI搜索引擎研发专家/工程师（上海/深圳/北京）
jd_text:
1.负责云存储多模态数据的检索和漏斗系统的设计与研发，保证服务稳定高效运行；
2.负责搜索引擎端到端的开发和运维，包括分布式系统研发、索引结构设计、漏斗策略及查询性能优化等等；
3.构建稳定高效的离线数据到在线索引的同步机制，保障数据的实时性与一致性；
4.优化倒排/正排/向量等索引的执行效率，优化系统资源消耗；
5.构建数据AI场景下高可用搜索框架，完善的监控与告警机制、全链路Trace、容灾备份及故障自愈能力，确保业务的连续性与极致的用户体验。
1.本科及以上学历，1年以上Faiss/Havenask/ElasticSearch 等系统的开发经验；
2.精通C/C++/Go/Java等至少一门语言，精通高并发、高性能、高可用分布式系统的原理，具有良好的编程和工程实践能力；
3.熟悉正排、倒排、向量、BitSet等常用索引结构；对Segment管理、打分机制（BM25/TF-IDF）及 Filter机制工作原理了解；有Hybrid Search（关键词+向量） 落地经验；
4.精通引擎筛选漏斗逻辑，理解召回/粗排/精排/重排等各层漏斗的实现机制及特点，能针对不同业务场景进行策略优化；

3.A参与设计大前端侧的 AI 基础设施，推进 MCP 的接入，打通底层数据逻辑与上层 AI 技能，构建稳定高效的端侧大模型调用与调度引擎；

5.熟悉 C/C++、Objective-C、Swift 或 Java/Kotlin 至少一门语言；
6.有 Chromium 架构、Electron、CEF 或 Flutter 等跨平台框架的实际项目落地经验；

1）负责大数据、数据湖存储（Data Lake / 湖仓一体） 、分布式计算、多模态数据处理、数据仓库、AI Search等一个或者多个产品的规划与落地；

2）有 B 端、公共云或 ToB PaaS 产品经验，熟悉售前支持与客户对接流程者优先。

title: 混元Agent数据策略分析岗（AI/Agent用户行为方向）（北京/深圳/上海）
jd_text:
1.需求洞察：持续追踪 Coding Agent / AI 编程助手领域的需求变化，通过用户反馈、行为数据、市场调研等多源信息，识别开发者的真实痛点、未满足需求及新兴任务形态，，输出周期性需求洞察报告；
2.UserLog 与 Agent 轨迹深度分析：对多轮对话、任务序列、工具调用和用户反馈进行深入分析，研究任务如何产生、演化和结束；识别模型在需求理解、规划、探索、执行、验证和交付等环节的困难点与失败机制；
3.用户体验与Agent行为质量的观测：从 0 到 1 设计用户体验指标体系。除满意度、留存和问题解决率外，进一步研究沉没成本、用户情绪变化、Agent 可引导性等信号，建立常态化监测机制；
4.探索性分析与假设验证：运用统计分析、聚类、大模型等方法，从海量用户数据中发现未被分类体系覆盖的新问题和新机会，主动提出「可能是什么问题 / 机会」的猜想，并设计验证方案去证实或证伪；
5.数据看板与归因：搭建核心指标看板，持续跟踪关键指标变化，对异常波动进行归因分析，定位问题根因并给出改进建议；
6.策略输入：将洞察转化为可执行的产品策略、模型优化方向和数据建设优先级，协助识别高价值训练样本、评测题、失败 Case、Rubric、Skill 等；
7.跨团队协作：与算法、产品、工程团队紧密配合，推动洞察结论在产品中落地，并跟踪落地效果形成闭环。
1.2年以上数据分析 / 策略分析 / 市场洞察相关经验，具备扎实的数据分析功底，有产品数据科学、计算社会科学或消费者洞察背景优先；
2.熟练使用 SQL、Python（Pandas 等），能独立完成数据提取、清洗、分析与可视化，有 AI / Coding Agent / 开发者工具 / SaaS 产品相关经验者优先；
3.具备敏锐的市场洞察力与需求分析能力，能从数据和用户反馈中提炼出有说服力的结论，有用户满意度指标体系（NPS / CSAT / 留存）搭建与运营经验；
4.有指标体系设计与数据看板建设经验，能够使用包括大模型在内的分析工具提升效率，具备独立检查报告可靠性与正确性的能力。

title: 腾讯云数字金融行业解决方案架构师
